_comment: Human-verified national-portal links, for projects that automated discovery could not match. Tracked configuration, not derived data — a per-project result.json write would satisfy today's dataset and nothing else, and the next --fresh run would drop it with no record it had ever been found. Regenerating this file is not a thing: every entry is a person's reading of a portal page. Mirrors data/project_aliases.json, which is tracked for the same reason.
_usage: Applied by urtpe.links.load_twur_overrides at cache-load time, and ONLY where discovery found no link. A project that discovery resolved keeps its own link, so a record here can never overwrite what the portal actually returned. Records missing any evidence field are ignored and reported. Run `unattached_overrides` to find records whose project_id has moved and no longer applies.

萬華區-崇仁新村青年段一小段-711-3地號等?筆.reason: Two independent causes, either fatal alone. (1) Search key: we search 崇仁新村青年段一小段 and the portal indexes the unit as 崇仁新村 — searching that returns ['18'], searching ours returns nothing. (2) Matcher: the portal writes a two-section title with a (原崇仁新村) anchor and no 等N筆 clause, so parse_name_id extracts district='', section='', parcel='' from it and view_page_matches correctly returns False. Our parcel is 711-3 where the portal says 711 — a renumbering, the 689地號(原726地號) case. DO NOT 'fix' this by loosening the parcel matcher: that would have to adjudicate 23 sub-parcel projects, and a false positive silently attaches another project's 推動歷程 to this one. Population across all 75 twur-less projects: exactly one has a project_id of the form 等?筆, meaning the current node's land string carries no 等N筆 clause and the count never parsed. n=1 — revisit this decision if a second case appears.
